How to apply
The University of St Andrews has different application routes for postgraduate students depending on the course you are applying for.
Taught programmes
Applicants for MSc, MLitt, MRes, Conversion Diploma, Postgraduate Diploma and Postgraduate Certificate programmes should apply online using the applications and guidance for taught programmes.
Research programmes
Applicants for MPhil, PhD, MSc(Res), MSt(Res), EngD, MFA and MRes Medicine programmes should apply online using the applications and guidance for research programmes.

Find out how we offer places or when you are likely to receive a response to your application.
